title: PermissionRuleHistory
description: `GET /permission-rules/:ruleId/history`: the events of one rule — granted, validity changed, revoked, restored (plan 15, B-11). A restored rule is a fresh `permission.ruleGranted`, with `restoredFrom` in `details`, not a kind of its own. The same facts `GET /audit-events` shows, filtered by this rule's id as the subject.
